name: Suō no Naishi
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 67); Porter’s note gives the dates as: fl. 1046–1068.

poems.title: If I had made thy proffered arm
poems.author: Suō no Naishi
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 67
poems.text:
If I had made thy proffered arm
A pillow for my head
For but the moment’s time, in which
A summer’s dream had fled,
What would the world have said?

poems.title: 67. 春の夜の 夢ばかりなる 手枕に (Haru no yo no yume bakari naru tamakura ni)
poems.author: Suō no Naishi
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 千載集
poems.text:
春の夜の 夢ばかりなる 手枕に
かひなく立たむ 名こそ惜しけれ
